use_fast_gi.name: Fast GI Approximation
use_fast_gi.description: Use faster global illumination technique for high roughness surfaces

enum.description: Use ambient occlusion instead of full global illumination
Compute global illumination taking into account light bouncing off surrounding objects

fast_gi_distance.name: Distance
fast_gi_distance.description: If non-zero, the maximum distance at which other surfaces will contribute to the fast GI approximation

fast_gi_thickness_near.name: Thickness
fast_gi_thickness_near.description: Geometric thickness of the surfaces when computing fast GI and ambient occlusion. Reduces light leaking and missing contact occlusion.

fast_gi_bias.name: Bias
fast_gi_bias.description: Bias the shading normal to reduce self intersection artifacts

ray_tracing_options.trace_max_roughness.name: Raytrace Max Roughness
ray_tracing_options.trace_max_roughness.description: Maximum roughness to use the tracing pipeline for. Higher roughness surfaces will use fast GI approximation. A value of 1 will disable fast GI approximation.

ray_tracing_options.screen_trace_quality.name: Screen-Trace Precision
ray_tracing_options.screen_trace_quality.description: Precision of the screen space ray-tracing

ray_tracing_options.screen_trace_thickne.name: Screen-Trace Thickness
ray_tracing_options.screen_trace_thickne.description: Surface thickness used to detect intersection when using screen-tracing
